generate_random_expression_tree: generate a random multi-dimensional expression tree with configurable input and output dimensions using RandomFunctions
generate_datapoints_from_tree: generate synthetic input-output datapoints from an expression tree using gaussian or uniform distributions
evaluate_node_tree: evaluate a Node expression tree on input data to compute output values using the val method
convert_tree_to_skeleton: convert an expression tree to a skeleton by replacing constants with placeholder tokens
add_linear_transformations: add linear transformations with random float prefactors to an expression tree
